method: Read the final KCS wording and the corresponding source-owner implementation on the same clean published HEAD; inspect each correction commit. No product implementation was changed in this review.
limits: These are documentation corrections, not new runtime-behaviour claims.
No native Tcl execution was performed for this review.
Full repository release gates remain pending.

issues.verified_wording: The KCS explicitly says info vars/info locals membership and catch {set _ $X} do not narrow W210.
issues.observed_owner_contract: The Read-before-set section explicitly excludes those idioms as existence proofs.

issues.verified_wording: Both stub paragraphs now say stub declarations do not check the call argument count.
issues.observed_owner_contract: UserResolutionFacts::resolves_to_user recognises stub names; flush_arity_diagnostics skips stubbed user-call candidates.

issues.verified_wording: The how-to says project configuration is watched, editor settings refresh when sent, and global config edits require restart.
issues.observed_owner_contract: register_file_watchers registers PROJECT_CONFIG_GLOB; did_change_watched_files invokes refresh_watched_configuration, which re-pulls settings and reschedules open and closed diagnostics. The watcher list has no global config path.

issues.verified_wording: The nonexistent local-only ignore-list workaround has been removed. Project-over-editor precedence and team coordination are stated.
issues.observed_owner_contract: settings_from_ini reads known INI settings; merge_settings recursively applies high-priority values over low-priority values. No per-key ignore-list facility is claimed.

issues.verified_wording: The quickstart no longer calls vocabulary 2.0 current; its 2.0 example and explicit CLI upgrade statement remain.
issues.observed_owner_contract: NEWEST_VOCABULARY_VERSION is 2.2. The CLI separately pins SpecUpgradeArgs.to to 2.0, although UpgradeOptions::default uses the newest vocabulary.
